data_fields.name: slot_bonus_building
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 (Space Elevator City_Radius_Sq effect; value line not receipted)

data_fields.name: slot_bonus_tech
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 (The Wheel City_Radius_Sq effect; value line not receipted)

best_idea: A hub's service footprint is a data-driven radius (base plus summed bonuses, clamped), changing slots only when the slot count changes; displaced services refill nearest-first or go idle.
decision_why: Frankendom hubs can take the footprint rule as zone data; the vision and specialist parts have no counterpart in our rulings.
acceptance: A server test: a hub gains slots from a bonus, loses it with services on lost slots; they move to the nearest free slot or show idle, and the stored radius equals base plus remaining bonuses.
